name: grandchild_in_jail
lines: Hello? Grandma? Can you hear me?
It's me, Kevin. Grandma, please don't be mad, I'm in really big trouble.
I was in an accident in Mexico and the police arrested me.
I am in jail right now and the lawyer said I need bail money right away.
You have to send five thousand dollars through a wire transfer immediately.
Please don't tell mom and dad, they will kill me. Just send the money so I can get out of this jail cell.
